title: Latvia Tightens Eastern Border and Bans Russian Goods in Twin Security Push · 05 Sep
keywords: Latvia, border security, Operation VILKATIS, Russia, Belarus, import ban, economic decoupling, hybrid threats, Baltic states, EU frontline, inflation, migration, sanctions
notes: Latvia has extended its eastern-border enforcement operation for another month and imposed a sweeping ban on industrial imports from Russia and Belarus, effective September 2026. The twin moves reflect Riga's deepening security anxiety and accelerating economic decoupling from its eastern neighbors. Together, they position Latvia as one of the European Union's most assertive frontline states in confronting hybrid threats and Russian economic influence.
